thread:
jordan: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of inbound HubSpot contacts created between 00:10-00:35 that never moved into our RR flow and stayed in 'unassigned'. Roughly 9% of that window. Anyone from ops around? :mag:

tessa: digging. CRM webhooks show a flurry of 504s from the enrichment gateway at ~00:22. Also seeing retries from HS that pile up and cause dup delivery backoff.

liam: quick hit: if enrichment backend slows, our routing decision times out and we treat the lead as unassignable -> goes to the unassigned queue. Two levers: raise routing decision deadline or change HS -> processing state behavior.

zoe: telemetry snippet: `select count(*) from leads where assigned=false and created_at between '2024-07-02T00:10Z' and '2024-07-02T00:35Z'` = 412. Baseline for that window is 38. p95 enrich latency=72s (normally 14s).

jordan: thanks. Immediate mitigation proposals: 1) bump routing window for night to 60s 2) create transient DLQ for retrying enrichment instead of immediate give-up 3) add HubSpot workflow to tag "enrich-pending" and not trigger RR until tag cleared. Which one can we safely ship fast?

tessa: I can toggle routing window in config now. Command: `infractl set service.routing.max_decision_ms 60000 --env prod --scope night` — will monitor for side effects.

liam: DLQ/backfill is non-destructive and low-risk. I can wire a short job to pick leads with tag 'enrich-pending' and re-run enrich attempts, then push into RR if claim succeeds. ETA 90m.

crm-bot: Webhook error burst detected: enrichment-gateway returned 504 (total 29 failures) between 2024-07-02T00:20:12Z and 2024-07-02T00:25:02Z. Auto-retries scheduled.

zoe: messaging to sales — draft: "We experienced delayed assignments for a subset of late-night inbound leads due to a temporary enrichment gateway timeout. We've extended the routing deadline for the night window and are reprocessing affected leads; no lead data lost. Please DM if you notice missing contacts."

jordan: roll forward with the toggle and DLQ plan. Also add a short-term HS workflow (hold RR while property `enrich_tag` == pending). Tessa, you good to flip the HS workflow?

tessa: can add HS workflow rule now. Quick rule: if `enrichment_status == pending` then set `lifecycle_stage` = Processing (prevent RR). Pushing to HS in 5m.

liam: starting backfill job — steps: 1) query contacts with `created_at` window and `enrichment_status = pending` 2) POST to /v1/enrich with idempotency token 3) on success push to rr-queue 4) if still unclaimed after 120s, move to overflow pool. I'll post job logs here.

jordan: FYI we should track SLA impact metric: "assign_latency_impact" to report % of leads assigned >30s. Add to weekly marketing dashboard.

crm-bot: Backfill job initiated by liam. Job id bf-20240702-01.

zoe: notified sales with the message above. Also added a little FAQ line: "If you see a contact in unassigned, label it #nightbackfill and ops will prioritize."

liam: backfill progress: reprocessed 412 leads, 389 moved into rr-queue, 23 routed to overflow. No duplicates. Posting summary soon.

jordan: solid. Next steps (longer term): - make enrichment asynchronous and let RR evaluate on partial enrichment signals - add graceful retry window for HS webhooks - instrument enrichment vendor latency with alert at p95 > 30s

tessa: done toggling routing window to 60s; canary traffic OK. I'll revert to 25s at 08:00 local unless we see further spikes.

zoe: sales message pinned. Also created a short status page entry for the interruption.

jordan: closing this thread once postmortem is up. Filing a ticket with eng for the async-enrich roadmap and the assign_latency_impact metric. :white_check_mark:
